# EVENTS

[Image: Restaurant exterior]

We offer full restaurant brunch, lunch & dinner buyouts for groups of up to 100.

To inquire about a restaurant buyout, please contact us at [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#6f0a190a011b1c2f030e1a010b0a1d0a1b1b0a0e1a1c1b0601410c0002).

Reservations can be booked [online](https://resy.com/cities/austin-tx/venues/launderette?seats=2&callback_url=http:%2F%2Flaunderetteaustin.com%2F&date=2025-01-16) up to 45 days in advance for up to 16 guests.

For groups of 17-30 please email us at [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#81e9e8c1ede0f4efe5e4f3e4f5f5e4e0f4f2f5e8efafe2eeec).

*Chef-owner Rene Ortiz crafts globally inspired Southern dishes for lunch, dinner, and weekend brunch.*


# JOIN US

Open for lunch Monday through Friday, dinner nightly and brunch on the weekends, we are an East Austin café tucked away in the Holly neighborhood. Our menu features vibrant and global flavors from Chef-Owner Rene Ortiz.

# Reservations

Schedule a reservation for seats at the bar, a table in the dining room or a spot on our covered outdoor patio.

[BOOK NOW](https://resy.com/cities/austin-tx/venues/launderette?seats=2&date=2025-04-10&callback_url=http://launderetteaustin.com/)

# Events

Host your next event at our place!

[More Info  about Catering](/austin-launderette-catering-and-event)
